items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Where he got Tiny Grimes, boy, I don't know...

ctx.x: I was there the first night he heard Slam Stewart. He decided to form his trio. Slam Stewart was the first bass player he had ever played that could talk with him, anticipate him and all that. He said, "Now there is my bass player. I've finally found a bass player. I'm going to form a trio now." Where he got Tiny Grimes, boy, I don't know...
Neither does Tiny. He said, "I don't know why he got me," because Tiny had such a hard time, you know, keeping up with him.
